At 11.6 impressions per post the algorithm is not distributing this content, so no headline, thumbnail or CTA change can be evaluated yet. Post 2–3× a week for four weeks, get a real person to engage within the first hour, and keep any destination link out of the post body — a bare link suppresses reach.

actions.title: Put one destination in every post
actions.detail: Link in the first comment, and a reason to click ("the 2-minute demo for a placement cell").

students.headline: 93 impressions and 2 engagement, but 0 clicks. Attention exists; there is no path from the post to the destination. Reach is the binding constraint here: 11.6 impressions per post across 8 post(s) — the platform showed this content to almost nobody, so there was never a real chance for it to convert.
